title: Configuration
description: What a server returns for a signed GET of /.well-known/qory-configuration, per access key: the access key's node, where the runner posts its events, where it fetches a run configuration when the server offers one, whether the access key is allowed stored secrets, and the server's keys. A section a runner does not recognise is ignored; an added section is a new revision of this contract.

version.description: The document format. A runner refuses a version it does not read.

node_id.description: The id of the access key's node, nd_, or node pool, np_, followed by 16 lower-case Crockford base32 characters. Listed for every verified access key, for display.

events.description: Where the events go and which.

url.description: The endpoint every batch is posted to. https, or http to a loopback address only.

types.description: The event types the server wants, by full type name, or * for every type. The ping is always sent.

run.description: Where the run configuration is fetched from, when the server offers one. A server whose document has no run section offers none, and the run's policy is the machine's.

url.description: The endpoint the run configuration is fetched from with a signed GET, every label of the run as its query, one parameter per label, sorted by key and percent-encoded. Which labels identify what the run works on is the server's to decide. https, or http to a loopback address only.

secrets.description: Present for an access key allowed stored secrets. A server that lists it requires a wall for every run against it.

url.description: https, or http to a loopback address only.

apiary_public_key.description: The server's Ed25519 public keys, the current one and during a rotation the next one after it, listed for every verified access key for information: a runner verifies under its pin alone.
